sections.markdown:
## C2 — Confusables and KG hints: licensing, tests and minor drivers

FACT_ID: sec01-R01 | anchor: A01
The general minimum age to drive in Colorado is 16, but a permit supervisor must be at least 21; do not mix up the driver age with the supervisor age. [A01]
Why it matters: group licensing; difficulty two; confusable sec01-F01 vs sec01-F09. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-co-s:colorado-department-of-revenue-division-:handbook:pdf-0004]

FACT_ID: sec01-R02 | anchor: A01
Three different Colorado deadlines share the same length: getting a Colorado license after becoming a resident and reporting a name or address change are both 30 days, while the residency example is 90 days of continuous living in the state. [A01]
Why it matters: group deadlines; difficulty two; confusable sec01-F02, sec01-F03, sec01-F05. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-co-s:colorado-department-of-revenue-division-:handbook:pdf-0004]

FACT_ID: sec01-R03 | anchor: A01
The written test is not offered in the final 30 minutes before closing, which is a scheduling rule and is different from the 30-day residency and address-change deadlines. [A01]
Why it matters: group deadlines; difficulty one; confusable sec01-F07 vs sec01-F05. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-co-s:colorado-department-of-revenue-division-:handbook:pdf-0004]

FACT_ID: sec01-R04 | anchor: A01
Anyone who fails the driving skills test must wait until the next business day before taking the drive test again [A01].
Why it matters: group testing; difficulty one; prereq sec01-F10. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-co-s:colorado-department-of-revenue-division-:handbook:pdf-0004]

FACT_ID: sec01-R05 | anchor: A02
Always turn right from the right-most portion of your lane and left from the left-most portion, then finish centered in the proper lane without crossing markings or curbs [A02] [A02].
Why it matters: group turning; difficulty two; confusable sec01-F19 vs sec01-F20. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-co-s:colorado-department-of-revenue-division-:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec01-R06 | anchor: A02
The turn signal distance depends on the road: 100 feet in urban areas versus 200 feet on four-lane highways, and either way the signal is canceled within 3 seconds after the move. [A02]
Why it matters: group signaling; difficulty two; confusable sec01-F21 vs sec01-F22. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-co-s:colorado-department-of-revenue-division-:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec01-R07 | anchor: A02
The minor log requires 50 total hours, of which 10 must be at night; the night hours are part of the total, not added on top. [A02]
Why it matters: group minor licensing; difficulty two; prereq sec01-F31. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-co-s:colorado-department-of-revenue-division-:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec01-R08 | anchor: A02
The 6 hours of behind-the-wheel instruction apply only to applicants younger than 16 and 6 months, and the 12 extra supervised hours are a substitute only where no qualifying school is within 30 miles. [A02]
Why it matters: group minor licensing; difficulty three; confusable sec01-F33 vs sec01-F34. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-co-s:colorado-department-of-revenue-division-:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec01-R09 | anchor: A02
Passenger limits step up with time licensed: none under 21 in the first six months without an adult driver, one under 21 after 6 months, and as many as there are seat belts after 1 year. [A02]
Why it matters: group minor restrictions; difficulty three; confusable sec01-F35 vs sec01-F36. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-co-s:colorado-department-of-revenue-division-:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec01-R10 | anchor: A02
The curfew window for first-year minors runs from midnight to 5 a.m., and a school or work trip is excused only with a signed statement from the school or employer. [A02]
Why it matters: group minor restrictions; difficulty two; confusable sec01-F37 vs sec01-F36. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-co-s:colorado-department-of-revenue-division-:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec01-R11 | anchor: A02
The Affidavit of Liability signer can be a spouse only if that spouse is older than 18, and withdrawing the signature cancels the minor permit or license. [A02]
Why it matters: group minor licensing; difficulty two; prereq sec01-F29. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-co-s:colorado-department-of-revenue-division-:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec01-R12 | anchor: A02
Losing your license can come from conduct after a crash, such as leaving the scene or not reporting it under the Financial Responsibility Law, not only from driving under the influence or points. [A02]
Why it matters: group license loss; difficulty two; confusable sec01-F38 vs sec01-F39. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-co-s:colorado-department-of-revenue-division-:handbook:pdf-0005]

Misconception: a back-up camera or lane-departure alert can stand in for looking over your shoulder during the drive test; it cannot. [A02]
Misconception: siblings count against the single under-age passenger allowance after the first months; siblings are an exception. [A02]
Mnemonic: Look Left, Right, Left before entering an intersection, then look Behind after the turn. [A02]
Glossary: Affidavit of Liability means the signed promise by an adult to accept legal responsibility for a minor driver. [A02]
Glossary: Instruction permit means a learner credential giving limited driving privileges under a qualified supervisor. [A01]
Glossary: AAMVA means the American Association of Motor Vehicle Administrators, whose guidelines shape the drive test. [A01]
Glossary: Push-pull-slide means a steering method in which the hands feed the wheel without crossing over. [A01]
